output_list.reason: The token devalue vulnerability can be exploited by the following steps: 1. The attacker could mint the tokens and send them to themselves. 2. Attacker burns half of totalSupply and sends remaining tokens to the attacker. 3. Attacker burns the remaining tokens and receives a much higher value of the token than it was initially minted for. This means that the attacker's tokens will have more value than the original token. Note that the tokens are still owned by the attacker after the burn operation. This is a Token Devalue vulnerability.
